entries.title: Job 10:1
segments: ¶My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul. {weary...: or, cut off while I live}

words.text: . {weary...: or, cut off while I live}

entries.title: Job 10:2
segments: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

entries.title: Job 10:3
segments: [Is it] good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked? {work: Heb. labour}

words.text: unto thee that thou shouldest oppress

entries.title: Job 10:4
segments: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

entries.title: Job 10:5
segments: [Are] thy days as the days of man? [are] thy years as man's days,

entries.title: Job 10:6
segments: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

entries.title: Job 10:7
segments: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and [there is] none that can deliver out of thine hand. {Thou...: Heb. It is upon thy knowledge}

words.text: ; and [there is] none that can deliver
. {Thou...: Heb. It is upon thy knowledge}

entries.title: Job 10:8
segments: ¶Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me. {have...: Heb. took pains about me}

words.text: me. {have...: Heb. took pains about me}

entries.title: Job 10:9
segments: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

words.text: , I beseech thee, that thou hast made

entries.title: Job 10:10
segments: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

words.text: Hast thou not poured me out

entries.title: Job 10:11
segments: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews. {fenced: Heb. hedged}

entries.title: Job 10:12
segments: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

entries.title: Job 10:13
segments: And these [things] hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this [is] with thee.

entries.title: Job 10:14
segments: ¶If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

words.text: me, and thou wilt not acquit

entries.title: Job 10:15
segments: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and [if] I be righteous, [yet] will I not lift up my head. [I am] full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

words.text: unto me; and [if] I be righteous

entries.title: Job 10:16
segments: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

entries.title: Job 10:17
segments: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war [are] against me. {witnesses: that is, plagues}

entries.title: Job 10:18
segments: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

words.text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth
? Oh that I had given up the ghost

entries.title: Job 10:19
segments: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

words.text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried

entries.title: Job 10:20
segments: [Are] not my days few? cease [then, and] let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

entries.title: Job 10:21
segments: Before I go [whence] I shall not return, [even] to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 10:22
segments: A land of darkness, as darkness [itself; and] of the shadow of death, without any order, and [where] the light [is] as darkness.

words.text: [itself; and] of the shadow of death
